name: Wehrhaft. Resilient. Nachhaltig. Integrierte Sicherheit für Deutschland: Nationale Sicherheitsstrategie (2023)
description: First National Security Strategy of the Federal Republic of Germany (adopted June 14, 2023). Germany's first comprehensive National Security Strategy, adopted by the Federal Cabinet on June 14, 2023 under the concept of 'Integrated Security' (Integrierte Sicherheit) across three dimensions: Defence-mindedness (Wehrhaft), Resilience (Resilient — including cyber, space, and critical infrastructure protection), and Sustainability (Nachhaltig).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by Bundesregierung der Bundesrepublik Deutschland (bundesregierung.de) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
relationToAISecurity: Addresses strategic emerging technology governance, AI security/capability priorities, and national resilience policy for Bundesregierung der Bundesrepublik Deutschland (bundesregierung.de).
